# Aggressotron - All spawn locations with map

![Aggressotron - All spawn locations with map](/uploads/674_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The challenges in Fallout 76 often require you to find and kill an Aggressotron. There are various locations, instances and events where you can find Agressotrons.

## Aggressotron Loot

- One each Scrap Aggressotron Head, Atomic Waste, Bottle Cap, Blueprint: Aggressotron Head, Blueprint: Aggressotron Blade, Blueprint: Electrified Aggressotron Blade
- One each of fuse, power relay coil, biometric scanner, terminal graphics card, circuit board (military standard) or vacuum tube
- Aluminum
- Fusion cells
- Aggressotron Blade
- Captured Aggressotron Head
- Contextual ammunition

## Aggressotron locations

- [Burning Springs] Athens
- Hornwright Estate
- Whitespring Resort
- CAMP Rapidan
- [Skyline Valley] Slumber Mill Motel (dead)
- Watoga: 5 Agressotron 
(friendly if quest "Mayor for a Day" is completed)
- RobCo Research Center
- Clarksburg: Rare
- Red Rocket Mega Stop: Rare
- Strikers Row: Rare
-Sugar Grove
- Watoga High School
